title: Farmagia
synopsis:
In Felicidad, farmers known as the Farmagia raise monsters under the peaceful rule of the Magus Diluculum. After the Magus passes, a power struggle erupts among forces using monsters to seize control. In the town of Centvelt, Farmagia Ten and his friends band together against the despotic new ruler, Glaza. Ten, his friends, and their home-grown monsters must stay strong to defend their freedom. 

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Seeds of War
episodes.synopsis:
What Ten wants more than anything is to be the Farmagia with the strongest buddy monsters in the Felicidad Underworld. But the stakes become much higher when Felicidad's denizens find themselves in sudden need of a new ruler.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Avrion in Revolt
episodes.synopsis:
Ten and Leii desperately try to fend off Zanas when he attacks the orphanage. Nares saves the day, but only after much damage is inflicted. This serves as the motivation for the young Farmagia to support Nares when she declares herself in open rebellion against Glaza, the new Magus.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Reunion in Enemy Territory
episodes.synopsis:
Ten, Leii, and Arche infiltrate Perfectus as a commando squad in order to eliminate Manas, the Oración general who leads it. There they encounter Emero, their friend who's been missing since childhood. Ten is exuberant at the reunion, but Emero's reaction is decidedly less cordial.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Ties That Bind
episodes.synopsis:
Ten wishes he could use Unite Blitz the way Emero does. Emero shows up again and for some reason he's even more hostile than before.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: To the City of Muscle
episodes.synopsis:
With Arche recovering from a sudden health issue, Ten and Leii go alone to Rahatluk to deal with Corpus.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Over My Dead Body
episodes.synopsis:
Corpus has taken Chica captive, and Ten, Leii, and Emero have little choice but to fight him on his own terms.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Price of Truth
episodes.synopsis:
A troubling secret about Arche comes to light, and it leads her friends into a challenging situation.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Chosen One
episodes.synopsis:
Ten, Leii, and Arche go to Sonrisa to rendezvous with Anzar and work out a plan for defeating L'Oreille.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Three Angels
episodes.synopsis:
Nares goes to Nadeyat'sya for peace talks with L'Oreille. But is there more going on than meets the eye?

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Through the Darkness
episodes.synopsis:
L'Oreille attacks the heroes with her dark arts, and it dredges up paralyzing trauma from Leii's past.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: A Brother's Path
episodes.synopsis:
Ten and friends are forced into battle against Reaper versions of all the Oración Seis, including Nares.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: The Dragons of Centvelt
episodes.synopsis:
The situation seems dire, as the Farmagia heroes must now contend with Magus Diluculum, their mightiest foe.

(Source: Crunchyroll)
